entries.reason: TCK JSON-RPC client sends task_id in params; the spec requires taskId. The same client bug makes the TCK skip the other JSON-RPC push CRUD tests (PUSH-CREATE-002, PUSH-GET-001, PUSH-LIST-001, PUSH-DEL-001, PUSH-DEL-002), so JSON-RPC push CRUD is covered only by this repo's tests (JsonRpcTransportTests.Push_config_roundtrip_and_delete_returns_empty_object).
